recommendations.summary: Primary PCI (PPCI) is recommended over fibrinolysis if anticipated time from diagnosis to PCI is < 120 min.
recommendations.notes: Preference for PPCI when timely primary PCI is available within 120 minutes.

recommendations.summary: If timely PPCI (< 120 min) cannot be performed in patients with a working diagnosis of STEMI, fibrinolytic therapy is recommended within 12 h of symptom onset in patients without contraindications.
recommendations.notes: Fibrinolysis favored when PPCI delays exceed target and patient presents early.

recommendations.summary: Rescue PCI is recommended for failed fibrinolysis or in the presence of haemodynamic/electrical instability, worsening ischaemia, or persistent chest pain.
conditions: failed fibrinolysis defined as ST-segment resolution < 50% within 60–90 min of fibrinolytic administration
recommendations.notes: Rescue percutaneous coronary intervention after unsuccessful fibrinolysis or clinical deterioration.
